archetypes.name: cli-surface-auditor
archetypes.rationale: Checks that only the dead CLI surface is removed while the live wrapper and degraded gate stay intact.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the plan for CLI dispatch and import-surface mistakes. Focus on stale registry rows, stale re-exports, over-pruned imports, and accidental changes to the live Step 0 wrapper path. Confirm the env baseline update follows from the deleted function. Cite repo files with path:line evidence for every finding. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
